t: Din ubbara umeniqa veyoledet beyom hakkippurim
s: Din ubbara umeniqa veyoledet beyom hakkippurim ubo h' seipim: ubbarot umeniqot — mitannot umashlimot beyom hakkippurim:

Ubbara shehericha maakal veim lo yittenu lah mehammaakal epshar shettappil ubbarah, lepi shehaubbar heriach reach hammaakal umitavveh lo, veim lo tokal mimmennu epshar sheyyitaqqer latzet venimtza shenehem mesukkanim — lochashin lah beoznah shehayyom hu yom hakkippurim ulay tukal lehitappeq, veim nityashsheba datah sheppasaq haubbar mittaavato al yede zikkaron zeh — mutab. Veim lo nityashsheba datah bazeh ella omeret tzerika ani leekol (ayyen beur dabar zeh besiman try"ch), o shehitchilu paneha mishtannim ap al pi shello omra tzerika ani leekol — tochabin kosh beroteb venotenin letok piha, shemma tityashsheb datah bazeh. Veim lo nityashsheba datah bekak vaadayin paneha meshunnim o sheadayin omeret tzerika ani — notenin lah min haroteb atzmo (pachot pachot mikkashshiur kemo sheyyitbaer besiman try"ch). Veim gam bazeh lo nityashsheba datah — notenin lah min hammaakal atzmo (pachot pachot mikkashshiur) ad shettityashsheb datah:

Velo meubberet bilbad, ella apillu kol adam sheheriach maakal venishtannu panayv — mesukkan hu im lo yittenu lo litom mehammaakal, lepikak maakilin oto beyom hakkippurim kederek shemmaakilin et hamubberet shehericha, abal im lo nishtannu panayv ap al pi sheomer tzarik ani leekol — en maakilin oto. Ella im ken hu choleh, sheaz apillu lo heriach reach maakal vehu omer tzarik ani, o sheharopeim omerim shehu tzarik leekol — maakilin oto miyyad shetztzarik lo, kede hatztzarik lo. Velo ameru litten lo techilla min haroteb, ella bimubberet o mi sheheriach reach hammaakal, sheen lahem velo lanu omed beyishshub datam, peamim mityashsheb beroteb upeamim shetztzerikin lehammaakal atzmo, lepikak medaqdeqin immahem bekol mah sheepshar, abal choleh shemmaakilin oto al pi ropeim beqiim — notenim lo kepi mah sheomerim habbeqiim. Veken im maakilin oto al pi atzmo sheomer tzarik ani — notenim lo ad sheyyomar day. Ella shetztzarik lizzaher lehaakil oto pachot pachot mikkashshiur, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman try"ch:

Yoledet tok shelosha yamim — lo titanneh kelal, apillu omeret eni tzerika — maakilin otah beal korchah. Umikkol maqom yesh lehaakilah pachot pachot mikkashshiur, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman try"ch. Mishshelosha yamim ad sop shibat yamim lelidtah, im omra tzerika ani leekol ap al pi shechabroteha veken haropeim omerim sheenah tzerika — ap al pi ken maakilin otah miyyad pachot pachot mikkashshiur, kemo sheyyitbaer sham. Mikkan vaelak — hare hi kishar choleh sheen bo sakkana, lepi shebbevadday en shum sakkana mechamat halleda leachar shiba yamim lelidtah. Lepikak apillu im omra tzerika ani leekol mechamat tzaar halleda — en maakilin otah, kevan sheen sakkana baddabar. Abal im omra tzerika ani leekol mechamat shemmitkabbed alay choli — maakilin otah kederek shemmaakilin kol choleh sheomer tzarik ani, kemo sheyyitbaer sham, ayyen sham:

Sheloshet yamim ellu, veken shibat yamim ellu — en monin otam meet leet, kegon im yolda bez' betishre achar chatzot hayyom — en mechashshebin hashshelosha yamim ad achar chatzot hayyom shel yom hakkippurim, ella mechashshebin otam lepi seder yeme bereshit, veyom hakkippurim hu yom rebii lelidtah. Veim omra eni tzerika — en maakilin otah kelal. Abal bistam sheenah omeret kelum, o sheomeret sheenah yodaat im hi tzerika — maakilin otah, ella im ken shechabroteha o haropeim omerim sheenah tzerika, sheaz en maakilin otah, ella im ken omra beperush tzerika ani leekol:
